g.text: Zero GPU Memory Retained While Waiting in Batch Queues
PCIe DMA: Page-Out on Tool Pause (t_wait > T*)
TIER 2: Host DDR5 DRAM (Prefix Cache & Suspended Sessions)
Radix Prefix Tree & Paused KV Pages
